description: Cancels an envelope that has not been signed yet. The signing link stops working immediately and the signer sees a cancellation page. This cannot be undone, and an already-completed document cannot be voided. Ask the user to confirm in their own words before calling this, then pass confirm:true.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user has explicitly agreed to cancel this specific envelope.

name: void_envelope
title: Cancel an envelope
